opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (Adelphi co-sponsored), up to £300 (virtual)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C: PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences; non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society, SIG, non‑Society, and virtual) by providing travel, accommodation and registration grants.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course. Students need a supervisor letter; others need at least one year membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics/genomics training courses or collaborative visits.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports field‑based genetic research projects by covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and related costs.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship levels up to a few hundred pounds, up to about £1,000 for a session, major sponsorship £1,000–£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time; applications should be submitted at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, including venue, speaker and Carer’s awards.
